Yamato: "Huh? The elevator's moving. You don't see that often.
Is someone on it, I wonder?"
Touya: "Well, people do ride it."
Yamato: "But every time I look, it's stopped.
Right on the floor I'm on, too."
Touya: "You're imagining things. Imagining things. Anyway..."
Yamato: "Oh, it stopped."
Fain: "Hahahahaha!
To defend my beloved, the blade of justice smites the enemy!
With crimson blood burning red, such is a man's path in life!
A man of justice and truth!
Faaain, Jiiin, Baaaarion!!
I have arrived! For justice... I can die!"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "...Huh?"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "Aah!"
Fain: "H-Hey! Don't ignore me!
I was waiting specially for you..."
Touya: "...Get Gabon to take a look at you sometime."
Fain: "What?! I couldn't be healthier!
I'm not weak enough to get sick!
Dahahahaha!"
Yamato: "...It's a serious case."
Fain: "...So, what did you think? I'm pretty confident
in this one. Ah, my own talent frightens me."
It's pretty good, isn't it?
It's like enka.
Fain: "Isn't it? Especially the last part!
I get a thrill just saying it."
Yamato: "He's lost in admiration of himself... It's terminal."
Touya: "R-Right. Well, keep at it."
Fain: "'Enka'? What's that?"
Yamato: "Hmm... Maybe something like 'the song of the Japanese
heart'?"
Fain: "Heart? You mean a song that resonates
straight through the soul?"
Yamato: "W-Well, something like that."
Fain: "Oh! So my proclamation is just that
magnificent!"
Yamato: "Y-Yeah... Maybe..."
Fain: "Dahahahaha! You understand perfectly!"
Yamato: "By the way, Fain, why are you so
straightforward?"
Fain: "Heh heh heh... Because I believe in justice!
Dying for it would be my heart's desire!
And that justice is also for protecting those I hold dear!"
Touya: "Huh. Those you hold dear, eh..."
Fain: "Yes! For the princess, for Miss Ymir,
and for K-Kasumi... No! My justice is not
so fickle! Oh, what am I to do...?"
Yamato: "...What do we do?"
Touya: "Better keep our distance..."
Fain: "We're friends, aren't we?!
Tell me, who am I supposed to fight for?
I've decided in my heart that I'll love only one woman.
But I bear the noble and supreme
duty of guarding the princess. I can abandon neither love nor loyalty.
Ah... What a trial! This is the fate of a knight!
Then I shall press on! To fight destiny!
No, wait. But if one desires too much at once,
it's the same as losing everything, as my master said.
Does that mean I must follow one path or the other?!
Oh! How can this be?!
And choosing between Miss Ymir and Kasumi...
Damn it! It's all because those ≪Ze=Ode≫ bastards...
If not for them, I would never have had to suffer
like this...
Wait! Is this their conspiracy?!
Grrrrr! Damn them... How despicable...
No, how fearsome ≪Ze=Ode≫ is!
But I, Fain Jin Barion, will not let a little thing like that
break my spirit! Hmm? Does that mean,
to turn their plan against them, I must preserve my love for two women
and my loyalty to the princess
all at once?
No, but then I'd be defying my master's teaching.
Aaaah! What am I supposed to doooo?!"
Fain: "...Huh? Touya? Heeey..."
Yamato: "...He has it hard too."
Touya: "Well, he seems to find it fulfilling in his own way.
Anyway, let's go."
Yamato: "Y-Yeah..."
Derock: "Honestly, waiting so long for this elevator
is getting on my nerves... Oh."
Yamato: "Oh, Derock..."
Touya: "...What are you muttering about?"
Derock: "Oh, it's you two..."
Derock: "Oh, at last it's here.
Hmm? You're not getting on, then?
I'll get on, in that case."
Yamato: "Hey! We're getting on!
Wait your turn!"
Derock: "...Tch."
Derock: "Hurry up and move to the side.
I can't get on if you stand right in the middle."
Touya: "Yeah..."
Derock: "Heave-ho."
Derock: "W-What? What on earth is going on?"
Yamato: "It seems overloaded."
Derock: "That's impossible. It can hold up to 10 people,
and 20 lot (1 metric ton)."
Yamato: "How does that work?
Your calculations are a mess!"
Derock: "There are many things in this world
that common sense can't explain."
Touya: "...Who cares? Just get off.
That beeping is noisy."
Derock: "Getting off won't have anything to do with it..."
Touya: "The sound... stopped."
Derock: "W-What are you saying?
The malfunction happened to fix itself at the exact moment I got off.
Watch closely. I'll get on again."
Yamato: "It is overloaded."
Derock: "N-No! I-It's just broken!"
Touya: (He just doesn't know when to give up...)
Yamato: "That beeping is annoying, so get off for a moment."
Derock: "A-All right..."
Touya: "That malfunction fixed itself at just the right moment again, huh?"
Derock: "I-I'm in a hurry.
It'll be fine if you get off.
Hurry up and switch places with me."
Yamato: "What's that supposed to mean?!"
Sure.
No way.
Derock: "You're a good person."
Touya: "I think it'll be the same even if we get off, though..."
Derock: "N-No, it won't.
It'll definitely be all right."
Yamato: "There you go."
Derock: "..."
Touya: "Oh? Looks like it's okay."
Derock: "Naturally. I'll go ahead, then."
Yamato: "Oh..."
Derock: "S-Someone help me!
The elevator's stopped between floors!
The lights are out too! I can't see a thing!
Heeelp!"
Touya: "So it wasn't okay after all..."
Derock: "I-It's moving again.
I-I'm saved..."
Yamato: "Looks like he just made it..."
Touya: "No way. We're in a hurry too,
so we're going first."
Derock: "W-What a horrible person.
Getting in my way when you know I'm in a hurry!
You're the lowest of the low."
Yamato: "Sorry about that."
Derock: "Just hurry up and go!"
Ai: "Coming!"
Ai: "Oh, Touya. What is it?"
Touya: "Nothing. I don't really have any particular business..."
Ai: "Hmm."
Touya: "W-What...?"
Ai: "Oh, right. Wait here a moment."
Ai: "Here you go."
Touya: "...What's this?"
Ai: "What do you mean? Chocolate bars.
This is dark, this one's got nuts, and this one's white."
Touya: "No, that's not what I mean..."
Ai: "What?"
Touya: "Where did you get these things?"
Ai: "Where? I had Bart get them for me.
You know there aren't any sweets here. So..."
Touya: "But aren't these from our old world...?"
Ai: "That's right. That's what I asked for.
And I think I'll have some left over, so you can have a share."
Touya: "...Hey, these are almost past their best-before date."
Ai: "It's fine, it's fine. All except some still have plenty of time."
Yamato: "And that 'some'?"
Ai: "Time's up."
Touya: "...Hey."
Ai: "Don't worry. They won't kill you.
Though I've got no evidence for that."
Touya: "Still, for my peace of mind..."
Ai: "This is the trouble with the throwaway generation...
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:16:02>How could you face the people who lived through
the postwar chaos if you act like that?"
Touya: "...You're from the same generation as me."
Ai: "Anyway, you shouldn't just throw everything away
without a second thought.
Now you understand, take them home and eat them. Got it?!"
Yamato: "..."
Ai: "...W-What?"
Yamato: "You didn't want to throw them away, so you pushed them onto us."
Ai: "Urk... I-It's not as though that couldn't possibly
be the case, maybe... Hahahaha..."
Touya: "..."
Ai: "...Sorry. Help me out.
I really hate throwing things away.
But there's no way I can eat all of these..."
Touya: "...Then you should have just said so."
Ai: "I was a bit embarrassed..."
Yamato: "But isn't it unusual for someone Ai's age
to say something like that?"
Ai: "Really? Well, I was always close to my grandma,
so maybe that's her influence."
Touya: "I see. Well, in that case, I'll help you out."
Ai: "Thanks."
Touya: "I'll take these, then."
Ai: "Yeah. I'm counting on you."
Yamato: "Well, we can't carry them around with us,
so let's head back to our room."
Touya: "Right."
Touya: "...Hey, these are almost past their best-before date."
Ai: "It's fine, it's fine. Some still have plenty of time."
Yamato: "And everything except that 'some'?"
Ai: "Time's up."
Touya: "Hey!"
Ai: "Don't worry. They won't kill you.
Though I've got no evidence for that."
Touya: "Still, for my peace of mind..."
Ai: "This is the trouble with the throwaway generation...
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:16:02>How could you face the people who lived through
the postwar chaos if you act like that?"
Touya: "...You're from the same generation as me."
Ai: "Anyway, you shouldn't just throw everything away
without a second thought.
Now you understand, take them home and eat them. Got it?!
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:16:09><FC:02:3E><FC:04:3C:1C:05>Well then, I'm counting on you!"
Touya: "H-Hey! Don't just decide that yourself.
And what do you mean, you're counting on me?"
Yamato: "...Well, we can't just throw them away,
so let's head back to our room."
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Touya: "...Well, we said that, but what do we do with these?"
Yamato: "Hmm. I can't eat that many.
I don't want cavities either."
Touya: "Well, I guess we'll eat our way through them little by little...
It isn't that hot here,
so they probably won't melt if we leave them out."
Yamato: "Right."
